row:
Dog adventures & trails w/my dogs as we navigate through life...🐾
I'm a certified (R+) dog trainer with a level 3 diploma in canine nutrition. Im also a certifed Canicross Insturctor and Canine Massage Therapist. I  specialise in Canicross training, paddlesports training,  & canine wellness. 
I help dogs enjoy life with their people on land & water. :) 
Located near Greater Manchester. 
For information about my services visit www.nauticaltails.co.uk or email me at nauticaltailsuk@gmail.com 
For courses and other content you can support me on Patreon!
